title: Hammocks over Beds
description: Replaces the bed model with a custom hammock model. [26.2 Snapshot 3+]
body:
Pretty simple resource pack, replaces beds with hammocks.

Felt compelled to do this when I learned beds became actual models instead of block entities in 26.2 Snapshot 3. Due to this, this pack works on vanilla Minecraft.

The log that the hammock is tied to does not align with fences. That is intentional.
